description: Four men outside a wooden-framed building with woven matting walls and rolled reed blinds, gathered around a seated guitarist. One man in olive-drab fatigues and utility cap leans against the doorway at left. The guitarist, seated on a folding chair in a white polo shirt and dark slacks, plays a light-colored archtop guitar with a decorated body. Two more men stand at right in off-duty civilian clothes (pale sport shirt and dark slacks; white T-shirt, white trousers, sunglasses). Behind them: a low sandbag revetment wall, a large olive-drab general-purpose tent with wooden framing and screened sides, utility pole and overhead wires, bright sunny sky. A can sits on the ground by the guitarist's chair.
